_doc: Reference coordinates measured on a 1280x720 capture with 100% UI. 'panel' regions are relative to the top-left corner of the anchor; 'top_center' regions are relative to the top center of the screen. Format: [x, y, width, height]. Source: tests/fixtures/720p_0036.png. The clock moves down during age-up: the region is tall and the reader searches for the text band shaped like a clock. Villager/idle regions are 30 px wide (fit 3 digits) with 1 px margin above/below: two-digit counts touched the old 20 px region and lost a digit.

anchor._doc: Template = food/wood/gold/stone column (without the house: at the population cap it turns red with a '!' and dragged the score down). template_offset = position of the template relative to the anchor origin, which is still the top of the house (ref_pos).

production._doc: Production queue above the panel. Region relative to the anchor. templates: [file, scale at which it was cropped]: bottom row (with progress bar) from 720p_0117 and summary icon (top row) from 20261028-164311_1920x1351.

age_region._doc: Age numeral (I-IV) and age-up bar above the clock, relative to the top center (reference coordinates). Numeral: bright-gold mask matched against equal-width templates (assets/age, cropped at scale 1.485 from session 20261028-200819). Bar: columns of the band must be dark track or bright fill; builders = white digits right of the bar.
